This Criminal Original Petition has been filed seeking to quash the charge sheet in C.C.No.304 of 2023 on the file of the Judicial Magistrate Court, Radhapuram.

by the 2nd respondent, the 1st respondent registered the First Information Report in Crime No.71 of 2022 for the offences punishable under Sections 384, 420 and 506(i) of IPC, against the petitioners.

entities.text: First Information Report in Crime No.71 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: It appears that it is a dispute between the contractor and the employee.
A complaint has been given as if the accused persons have misappropriated and cheated the victims' money.
3. The further contention of the petitioners is that they compromised the issue with the 2nd respondent amicably.
A joint memo of compromise was filed, which has been duly signed by the petitioners and the 2nd respondent and also by their respective counsels.

Now it has been compromised between the parties and the victims have retaken into employment.
4. The petitioners and the 2nd respondent appeared before this Court along with their counsels and also produced their Aadhar cards.
They were also identified by the learned Additional Public Prosecutor and the Investigation Officer.

Both the parties were enquired by me and they accepted t h e t e r m s o f c o m p r o m i s e . H e n c e , t h e C o m p r o m i s e M e m o i s r e c o r d e d .
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.(MD) No.15886 of 2023 5.

Considering the totality of the circumstances, the nature of the allegations levelled against the petitioners and also in view of the joint compromise memo, dated 21.06.2023, this Court is of the opinion that no useful purpose will be served by keeping the matter pending.

Hence, all further proceedings in C.C.No.304 of 2023 pending on the file of the learned Judicial Magistrate Court,
Radhapuram, is quashed and the compromise memo is recorded.

6. In the result, the Criminal Original Petition stands allowed and the entire proceedings in C.C.No.304 of 2023 pending on the file of the learned Judicial Magistrate Court, Radhapuram, is hereby quashed in respect of the petitioners and the terms of joint compromise memo shall form Tamilraja vs The Inspector Of Police on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126031483/
